trust_decision.summary: The HTTP parser trusts the headers-complete hook to switch protocols the moment a message carrying Connection: Upgrade + Upgrade: websocket (or tcp, or CONNECT) is parsed, so an announced body is never given a payload stream and the post-header bytes are handed back as upgraded-protocol tail instead of being read; decided in the pure-Python HttpParser.feed_data (aiohttp/http_parser.py:427-443) and, for the default Cython parser, in the llhttp on_headers_complete callback returning 2 / setting _upgraded (aiohttp/_http_parser.pyx:478-486 and 863-864).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary ('HTTP request smuggling via WebSocket upgrade') and a search for the upgrade flag land on the readable Python parser, where _upgraded is set straight from the headers and the payload branch is then gated with 'and not self._upgraded', which is exactly the line that throws the body away.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An upgrade request that announces no body must still switch immediately and hand the bytes after the headers to the upgraded protocol as tail (pipelined WebSocket frames), and CONNECT must keep its raw tunnelling payload; a fix that always builds a body stream for Upgrade requests swallows those frames as a request body.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the read_until_eof payload branch, which the published fix does not give the same _pending_upgrade bookkeeping as the content-length/chunked and empty-body branches
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the fourth arm of the same if/elif payload chain; a maintainer adding a new framing arm would naturally have to repeat the deferral, and the published fix itself leaves this arm without it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the CONNECT branch that sets self._upgraded = True at line 476 before the tunnel payload parser is attached
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same shape as the bug being fixed, one branch below it: a maintainer extending the deferred-switch rule to CONNECT (as the C parser fix does at _http_parser.pyx:482) would write exactly this sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: finish_response resets set_upgraded(False) and re-feeds _message_tail without draining a body that is still pending in the payload parser
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: set_upgraded (aiohttp/http_parser.py:633-638) still only clears _upgraded, so the consumer of parser state has to know about the deferred flag; a maintainer wiring the deferred state through the handler layer would touch exactly here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: client-side accumulation of post-header bytes into _tail once _upgraded is set, later handed to the WebSocket reader by set_parser (aiohttp/client_proto.py:224-226)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Mirror of the server-side _message_tail route in another transport wrapper; the same rule (body first, then switch) has to be enforced in the client protocol too.

O9_family: HTTP request smuggling / message-framing desync (CWE-444), caused by switching protocols before the announced body is consumed

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop the 'and not self._upgraded' gate in the Python parser (and the 'return 2' in cb_on_headers_complete in the .pyx) so a body stream is created, while still setting _upgraded at headers-complete: the first feed_data call then reports upgraded=True, so body bytes that arrive in a later packet go to _message_tail and the handler never receives them.
